effects.name: target-store-merge-boundary
effects.detail: when a replayed merge writes an incoming MergeRecorded, its ours_head is the digest on the receiving chain at which its replayed block begins (the replayed counterpart of the source boundary, or the staging head where that boundary was filtered); theirs_head keeps the source value; the record keeps its source claims; the merge's records are written in its one atomic commit, and a refused merge writes nothing

effects.name: replay-origin-envelopes
effects.system: the target (ours) Vouch store's event log
effects.detail: new event envelopes are version 2; a record written by merge replay carries origin, the digest of the first-authored occurrence of its fact (inherited unchanged by a copy of a copy), and whether that origin is a version-1 or version-2 record; the merge's own final record carries satisfied, the origins of source facts it accounted for without writing a record; a companion replay generates carries generated: true and no origin, and its copies carry origin, origin_format 2 and generated; a directly authored record carries none of these; origin, satisfied and generated are claims written by the merging tool, trusted like a merge record's heads

effects.name: state-format-7
effects.detail: every snapshot write uses state format 7; a format-6 store is refused until upgrade rewrites only the format number, keeping its revision, head and event objects, and reports how many version-1 merge markers the store holds

effects.name: source-ancestry
effects.source: the source (theirs) and target (ours) Vouch stores' verified event chains, including origin and satisfied fields and version-1 merge blocks
effects.capture: which source command batches are already incorporated on ours by exact digest, D-38 block or origin, and so are not replayed; a refusal (merge.ancestry-unproven for version-1 history, merge.conflict for a missing generated companion, merge.theirs-history-invalid for a malformed origin or an unlocated legacy boundary) names the record and writes nothing, before any lock
